role: 2027 Winter Co-op Data Engineering Software Developer
jd:
Job Description

Vacancy Status: 

This posting is not for an existing vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications. (New Head Count)

AI Disclosure:

As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role.

Work Arrangement: 

Hybrid: This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Oshawa Elevation Centre (OEC) three times per week at minimum, or other frequency dictated by the business.

About GM:

At General Motors we pride ourselves on designing, building and selling the world's best vehicles. We are seeking a new generation of visionaries to help launch bold engineering and business initiatives, and shape new directions for General Motors. As an intern or co-op student through our EXCEL (Exploring Careers through Experiential Learning) Program you will gain hands-on career specific experiences to maximize your real world potential.

Collaborating on innovation challenges, interacting with Industry leaders, attending cross-functional networking events and volunteering for community service activities.

The Role

The Data Engineering organization at General Motors is driving innovation by harnessing data to shape the future of mobility. We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Co-Op Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development of software pipelines that configure the behavior of vehicle data recording systems, including both the Control and Data planes. This position requires a solid foundation in software development principles and strong collaboration skills to work effectively across diverse engineering teams. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, a passion for data-driven systems, and experience in managing and scaling data flows.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)



- Develop and maintain configuration files that define the operational state of the vehicle’s Control and Data planes.
- Design, implement, and maintain software pipelines to verify the integrity of vehicle data and control plane parameters.
- Build software tools to ingest, cross-check, manage changes, and release data recording configuration files.
- Create workflows for automated verification of configuration parameters.
- Maintain detailed records of configuration files, including parameter definitions, boundaries, optimal values, and system-level impacts.
- Support CI/CD and DevOps initiatives for automated integration, testing, and release of vehicle data recording software parameters.
- Analyze vehicle data logs to identify discrepancies and optimize system performance.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of vehicle data recording and analytics software.


Required Qualifications:



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering or equivalent
- Eligible to work full time hours, 40 hours a week for a term of 4 months (consecutive semesters) starting January 2027


Preferred Qualifications:



- Strong understanding of software development principles and best practices.
- Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C/C++.
- Prior experience with Eco Car/ Auto drive or similar projects.
- Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and workflow automation.
- Solid grasp of logging and data processing concepts.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented mindset.
- Experience with calibration/configuration tools and processes.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their logging services.
- Contributions to data-intensive open-source projects.
- Expertise in CI/CD pipelines and automation tools.
- Knowledge of embedded software development and optimization


NOTE- YOU MUST BE ENROLLED IN A CO-OP PROGRAM AND MEET THE PROGRAM’S ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS. ALL STUDENTS MUST ALSO BE LEGALLY ENTITLED TO WORK IN CANADA.

The monthly salary range for this role is $4,264.00 to $4784.00. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

Sponsorship: PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU DO NOT NEED SPONSORSHIP TO WORK IN CANADA NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. WE ARE UNABLE TO CONSIDER CANDIDATES WHO REQUIRE SPONSORSHIP

THIS JOB IS NOT ELIGIBLE FOR RELOCATIONS BENEFITS. ANY RELOCATION COSTS WOULD BE THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE SELECTED CANDIDATE.

Accommodation is available for applicants with disabilities. Should you be contacted by General Motors of Canada Company, please advise if you require accommodation.

For more information about GM Canada, visit our website at www.gm.ca/careers

General Motors of Canada values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer

About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

Why Join Us 

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities

General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.

To learn more, visit How we Hire.

Accommodations

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

2027 Summer Intern - GCS ML Sequencing 

Department Summary
At Global Customer Support (GCS) Molecular Labs Sequencing, we serve as the vital bridge between innovative R&D and global field operations to deliver best-in-class customer support and customer enablement. We drive global launch readiness, hypercare, technical training, and complex issue resolution across our cutting-edge sequencing portfolio—including the AXELIOS platform and on-market products. By combining deep technical expertise across Hardware, Software, Applications, and Bioinformatics with a culture of continuous improvement, our multi-disciplinary team empowers partners and customers worldwide to transform complex sequencing challenges into impactful healthcare solutions.

This internship position is located in Santa Clara, CA, On-Site.

The Opportunity



- Support affiliates and countries in troubleshooting by training AI tools using RDK and Smarteeva closed cases alongside knowledge transfer documents
- Build dashboards to identify insights and trends from current tickets, resolutions, and complaint cases (GCS and PMQ) focusing on data insight and knowledge management
- Analyze historical support data to streamline troubleshooting workflows
- Support knowledge management initiatives across global support teams
- Undertake other business-related projects as assigned

Program Highlights



- Intensive 12 weeks full-time (40 hours per week) paid internship
- Program start dates are in May (Summer). 
- A stipend, based on location, will be provided to help alleviate costs associated with the internship
- Ownership of challenging and impactful business-critical projects
- Work with some of the most talented people in the biotechnology industry


Who You Are (Required)
Required Education:



- Must be pursuing a Bachelor's Degree (enrolled student)

Required Majors: Engineering, Bio-Science, Life Science, Computer Science or relevant major.

Required Skills


- Proficiency or familiarity with data analysis/visualization tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python, Excel, or dashboarding software) and AI tools (e.g., training AI troubleshooting tools/models)


Preferred Knowledge, Skills, And Qualifications


- Foundational knowledge in life sciences, electronics, bioinformatics, library preparation, or sequencing application workflows are preferred though not mandatory
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
- Complements our culture and the standards that guide our daily behavior & decisions: Integrity, Courage, and Passion

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. 

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $23 -$45. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This position also qualifies for paid holiday time off benefits.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

role: Associate Forward Deployed Solution Engineer Intern (Bachelors Summer 2027)
jd:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.

Team bio  
 ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet real-world impact. We work with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. We find high-value opportunities, speed up business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that make the ServiceNow AI Platform even better. 
 Why this internship matters  
 Enterprises want AI that delivers real value, not just potential. Our Associate FDEs turn the latest LLM capabilities into secure, scalable software that customers rely on. As an Associate FDE Intern, you’ll learn how that happens by doing it. You’ll join a live delivery team, build real features, and see how great engineers take an idea from whiteboard to working solution. 
 Who you are  
 You’re a curious, hands-on builder who likes making things work. You’ve experimented with LLMs, APIs, or AI tools in class projects, hackathons, or on your own time. You enjoy solving messy problems, you ask good questions, and you want to understand why something matters to the people using it, not just how it works. 
 Location: Expectations to be hybrid in office - either Santa Clara, CA or New York, NY 
 What you’ll do  
 
• Build and test components of LLM-enabled applications, including backend services, data pipelines, prompts, and UI elements, under the guidance of senior FDSEs 
 
• Join customer working sessions to see how FDEs uncover problems, scope solutions, and iterate quickly 
 
• Help create reusable assets such as code samples, prompt libraries, scaffolds, and documentation that speed up future projects 
 
• Prototype and evaluate new AI techniques (retrieval, agents, prompt chaining) and share what you learn with the team 
 
• Work in agile sprints, with code reviews, stand-ups, and demos 
 
• Deliver an internship project and present it to FDE and product leaders at the end of your program 
 What success looks like  
 
• Shipped contribution: Your code or assets are used in a real customer build or internal tool 
 
• Reusable impact: You leave behind at least one documented pattern, prompt set, or scaffold the team keeps using 
 
• Growth: You get noticeably stronger at full-stack engineering, LLM tooling, and working with customers 
 
• Clear communication: You can explain what you built, why it matters, and what you’d do next

What you bring  
 
• AI curiosity: Experience using or thinking critically about how AI can improve work, decisions, or problem-solving, whether through coursework, projects, hackathons, or personal experiments 
 
• Education : Currently enrolled full-time in an accredited university pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. 
 
• Expected Bachelors graduation date of May 2028 or later, with plans to return to studies following the internship. 
• Available to work full-time for 12 weeks during the summer. 
• Programming fundamentals: Comfort with at least one language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java 
 
• Web basics: Familiarity with REST APIs and a frontend framework such as React or Angular 
 
• LLM exposure: Hands-on experience with an LLM API or framework (for example, LangChain or Semantic Kernel), prompt design, or vector search 
 
• Problem-solving mindset: Able to break down unclear problems, try things quickly, and learn from what doesn’t work 
 
• Collaboration: Clear communicator who enjoys working with teammates and is comfortable asking for help 
 
• Eligibility: Authorized to work in USA for the duration of the internship [confirm with Talent Acquisition] 
 Nice to have  
 
• Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Git, containers, or CI/CD 
 
• Familiarity with SQL, pandas, or basic ML concepts 
 
• A portfolio, GitHub profile, or project demo you’re proud of 
 
• Interest in enterprise SaaS platforms such as ServiceNow 
 For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $43.27 - $55.47 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas 
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  
 Accommodations 
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 
 Export Control Regulations 
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

Machine Learning Co-Op 
 Title of Direct Supervisor: Quality Process Improvement Engineer
 Co-op Duration:  2027; estimated to run from January 2027 - December 2027 
 Position Summary 
 The Machine Learning Co-Op supports the Quality Engineering team by contributing to machine learning initiatives that improve automated visual inspection, defect detection, and manufacturing efficiency.
 During the Co-Op's duration, the Co-op will assist with inspection data preparation, model training and validation, performance analysis, and optimization in collaboration with Quality Engineering, Manufacturing, and technical teams. Project deliverables will include documented results, recommendations, and a final presentation of measurable improvements.
 Local Primary Duties 
 
• Support machine learning (ML) initiatives focused on improving automated visual inspection, defect detection, and manufacturing efficiency. 
• Assist in the development, testing, validation, and optimization of machine learning models used in manufacturing quality inspection systems. 
• Collect, organize, label, and analyze manufacturing and inspection data to support model training, retraining, and performance evaluation. 
• Collaborate with Quality Engineering, Manufacturing, and technical teams to troubleshoot model performance and implement improvements. 
• Analyze model performance to identify opportunities to reduce false rejects, improve defect detection accuracy, and optimize inspection processes. 
• Document project progress, analyze results, and present findings, recommendations, and measurable improvements. 
• Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications 
 Required Education, Training and Experience 
 
• High School Diploma, GED or equivalent 
• Must be currently enrolled in a college degree program at a recognized institution of higher learning 
• Must be currently enrolled in a BS or MS Program in a related Systems, Biomedical, or Software Engineering and completed 1 full year. 
• To qualify for this Co-Op position, candidates must be actively enrolled in a participating university's formal Co-Op Program and meet all university requirements necessary to receive academic co-op credit. This includes enrollment in any required co-op course, program, or approval process established by the university. Students are responsible for maintaining eligibility and obtaining all required university approvals throughout the duration of the assignment.

Help us scale LinkedIn infrastructure to handle massive data growth across the LinkedIn ecosystem as we experience dramatic growth in membership and products.  • May 24th, 2027 - August 13th, 2027

• June 14th, 2027 - September 3rd, 2027

• Search, Networks and Analytics: Build and operate the platform that powers all of search at LinkedIn- which responds to thousands of queries per second with target latencies in tens of milliseconds. The platform runs in 24/7 production environment and enables search quality engineers to rapidly innovate, experiment and improve relevance- while at the same time remaining constantly available and performant to our users 
• Service: Provide the technical platform for all of LinkedIn Engineering to build services, which are the essential unit of development and deployment 
• Content and Community: Deliver the systems and algorithms that generate and serve feeds of professionally relevant activities and content

• Experience working in a short-cycle, agile, iterative development team.

• Knowledge of computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms,

software design, and object-oriented skills.
